NHS breach helpline left staff carrying a 'significant emotional burden'
Responding to a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request, the Royal Cornwall Hospitals NHS Trust uploaded a spreadsheet to its public FOI Disclosure log in February 2023. This contained personal data and inadvertently exposed sickness absence information and sensitive health data related to 7,715 staff, 288 non-trust workers, as well as a small number of unidentified records.
